title: On device storage with a small IndexedDB wrapper
when: The phone app must keep records on the device beyond what localStorage can hold, with schema upgrades and quota errors handled.
prompt:
Goal: db.js, a promise based wrapper over IndexedDB with versioned upgrades, safe writes and clear errors when storage is full or blocked.
Steps:
1. Export openDb(), get(store, key), put(store, value), del(store, key) and all(store), each returning a Promise.
2. indexedDB.open("app", 2); in onupgradeneeded switch on event.oldVersion without break: case 0 creates the "notes" store with keyPath "id", case 1 adds index "byUpdated" on updatedAt.
3. Resolve writes on transaction.oncomplete and reject on transaction.onerror or onabort, not on request.onsuccess.
4. Handle request.onblocked (an old tab holds the database) and set db.onversionchange = () => db.close().
5. After the first real save call navigator.storage.persist(); show navigator.storage.estimate() usage in settings.
6. Catch QuotaExceededError and tell the user what to delete; if open fails in a private mode, fall back to an in memory Map with a warning.
7. In a native shell the OS may clear WebView data under storage pressure; for data that must survive, also save a JSON export with the Filesystem plugin.
Quality bar:
- One open connection reused by every call.
- Upgrades run in order from any old version.
Pitfalls:
- Awaiting unrelated work inside a transaction, which auto commits it.
- Storing Date objects and class instances that come back as plain data.
- Assuming storage is unlimited on phones.
Verify:
- [ ] Upgrade cases cover every version.
- [ ] Writes resolve on oncomplete.
- [ ] Quota and open errors are caught and shown.
Output: db.js and a usage example in app.js.

examples.input: preciso guardar milhares de registros no celular offline
examples.output: db.js wrapper: versioned onupgradeneeded, writes on oncomplete, persist(), quota error message
